sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:45

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:45:1
items.html: “I sleep” opposite the last Hey. In the annulment of Ohr Nekudim, “I sleep”. The breaking of the vessels was primarily in the Behinat last Hey, and that’s where the sleeping comes to her. That is why sleep is implied in the last Hey.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:45:2
items.html: Hochma is the First Hey… … Nekudot are Hochma. It is written above (Ohr Pnimi item 44) that the Orot that rose to MAN from NHY de AK contain all the Nekudot de SAG, which are from Hochma down, with the ZON de AK. It is known that the Partzuf is named after its highest Sefira, hence the Nekudot are called Hochma.
